name: Kuhn poker
summary: A minimal two-player zero-sum poker with three cards, one ante, and one betting round.
rules_text: Ante 1 each. Deck has King, Queen, Jack. Each player gets one random card, third is unseen. Player 1 may check or bet 1. If Player 1 checks, Player 2 may check or bet 1. If both checked, showdown: higher card wins pot of 2. If Player 2 bets after a check, Player 1 may fold (Player 2 wins pot of 3) or call (showdown for pot of 4). If Player 1 bets, Player 2 may fold (Player 1 wins pot of 3) or call (showdown for pot of 4). In showdown higher rank wins, King > Queen > Jack. Winning player nets the difference.
rating_reason: Classic 2-player imperfect-information poker with hidden hands and betting
